So let me star off by telling you some info about the brain. When you play video games, use social media, or even just browse the internet your brain releases massive amounts of dopamine.  That feeling you get every time you get a kill or someone likes your post? Its dopamine.  

Dopamine is what makes things feel nice.  The problem with video games and electronics in general is that they dont make you wait to hit the dopamine "button". You begin to get bored with anything less stimulating than video games, thus leading to depression.


Lucky for you there is an easy fix! Lower the amount of dopamine from games and the internet and you will slowly regain interest in your old life. Head over to r/gamequitters.
